claims.statement: Green is promoted from transitional mono status only through this source-intake bundle, claim ledger, raw profile, raw placement packet, and generated QA; identity-layer or runtime text alone is not evidence.
Green seeks acceptance of the natural order, believing the world already contains the answers and each being has an innate role.
Green's means are nature itself: creatures, land, growth, life, interdependence, instinct, and slow purposeful evolution rather than artificial reinvention.
Green centers life, growth, nature, truth, community, interdependence, the past, wisdom, ancestry, tradition, instinct, animals, and plants; it despises unnatural change and artificial disruption.

Green is allied with White through community and with Red through instinct and wild action; it opposes Blue's nurture/artifice/future obsession and Black's self-interest/free-will assertion against natural responsibility.
Green's strength is certainty in the natural system, interconnection, primal power, mana, and creatures; its weakness is over-reliance on that system, especially when creatures are not the answer.

Green's mechanical texture includes efficient creatures, +1/+1 counters, mana and lands, Fight/Bite, reach, trample, artifact and enchantment destruction, card draw or filtering tied to creatures and lands, and anti-flying tools.
